title: SetProjectMeta Command
description: Store the project info every title block, the PDF metadata, the takeoff CSV header and the IFC read: project, project number, client, address, architect, date and revision, plus the stored scale label. Omitted keys stay as they are. An empty string clears that key.

date.description: The date the title blocks print. Unset prints the day of the Print.

revision.description: Revision letter or number, such as B. Unset drops the Rev. cell.

scale_label.description: Stored scale text. The detail scale on a layout still comes from layout_pack.
